LESSON: READING 2.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Sharing duties and responsibilities Suggested vocabulary share, duty, responsibi
Topic 2.2: Reading 2.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 2.2.1 Fluency, part of Sharing duties and responsibilities Suggested vocabulary share, duty, responsibi in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we check our speed while reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Watch a video or listen to an audio clip as teacher or peers model words featuring the target letter-sound combinations: ‘dr’, ‘fl’, ‘fr’ and ‘gl’. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. Screen resolution and light intensity could be regulated for learners who are sensitive to light.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Watch a video or listen to an audio clip as teacher or peers model words featuring the target letter-sound combinations: ‘dr’, ‘fl’, ‘fr’ and ‘gl’. Learners with postural defects or short stature could be appropriately positioned for comfort and clear view. Screen resolution and light intensity could be regulated for learners who are sensitive to light.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Digital literacy: The learner’s ability to interact with digital devices is enhanced as they watch a video clip and pick out words

with the target letter-sound combination.

 Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is reinforced as they practise reading texts from different

genres accurately, at the right speed and with expression.

14

Values:
Respect is heightened as the learner appreciates the effort of peers as they engage in timed reading activity.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to apply reading fluency skills when reading texts in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.
